correctness.rationale: For an irreducible symmetric-rate five-state generator, killing the target gives the displayed real-symmetric 4x4 Q. The passage density f=e_0^T exp(Qt)r has derivative e_0^T exp(Qt)Qr. Four sign samples at t=0.01,0.03,0.10,0.30 are +,-,+,-, with certified rational 400th-order Taylor intervals and spectral-norm tail <2e-107; independent expm checks give ~11.15970,-0.67305,0.02506,-0.13653. They force two interior maxima. For <=4 total states there are <=3 real exponential eigenmodes; the derivative of a nonzero sum of at most m distinct real exponentials has at most m-1 zeros, hence two maxima requiring three zeros need >=4 transient states. Repeated eigenvalues combine because reversibility diagonalizes Q. Initial state, target, full-chain irreducibility and uniform detailed balance checked.
